ja293:1.1: For me who was touched by a certain illness,
ja293:1.2: Oppressed with suffering by a strong disease,
ja293:1.3: This corpse of a body quickly shrivels up,
ja293:1.4: Like a flower that’s made to dry in the dust.
ja293:2.2: the impure is thought to be pure,
ja293:2.3: Not seeing this lovely form is full of many disgusting things.
ja293:3.1: Cursed be this unhealthy, putrid body,
ja293:3.2: Revolting, impure, whose nature is illness,
ja293:3.4: They neglect the path to rebirth in a good state.
